checks.name: READY remains stationary without input
checks.evidence: After 1250 ms wall-clock idle, status remained ready, position remained exactly x=210/y=522, failReason remained null, and desktop-ready.png shows the resting blade on the start platform.

checks.name: desktop mouse and Space launch/flip
checks.evidence: Real mouse input entered airborne with vx=320/vy=-384.17 and rotated 0.620 rad within 120 ms. Real Space entered airborne; repeated keydown did not emit a second alternating flip.

checks.name: first target cut and receiving-platform landing
checks.evidence: The first real mouse jump cut rune-1 and settled landed on step-1 at simulation elapsed 0.842; desktop-first-landing.png shows split feedback, the highlighted receiving platform, and the visible stable-next-jump instruction.

checks.name: complete course using visible landing states and real mouse edges
checks.evidence: Without reading hidden simulation elapsed, the reviewer reacted only to ready/landed/airborne state changes and used real mouse clicks. Five launches completed all 5 cuts and won at the ×4 zone with finalScore 20; desktop-result.png records the result.

checks.name: plus or minus 100 ms reaction tolerance
checks.evidence: Independent real-input runs using 300/400/500 ms final air-adjustment delays all won, each with 5 cuts, ×4, and score 20.

checks.name: early and late air flips change trajectory
checks.evidence: Real air flips at 180 ms versus 650 ms produced distinct samples: x=510.42/y=413.83/vx=395/cuts=1 versus x=618.14/y=439.74/vx=320/cuts=2.

checks.name: hazard contact and missed-finish failure
checks.evidence: From a visible step-2 landing, one real launch plus an early real air flip hit ban-2 and failed with reason hazard. From visible step-4, two real air flips overshot all finish zones to x=2031.07 and failed with reason fall; failure.png and fall.log preserve evidence.

checks.name: terminal one-input restart
checks.evidence: After a native-touch hazard failure on seed 41, one real native touch restarted immediately to ready on seed 42 with elapsed 0.

checks.name: finish multipliers and score calculation
checks.evidence: The finish visibly presents original wide-to-narrow ×2/×4/×8 zones. Actual ×4 landing reported multiplier=4 and finalScore=cuts(5)×4=20, matching desktop-result.png.

checks.name: mobile native touch, landing, failure, restart, and containment
checks.evidence: At 390x844, native touch launched, cut rune-1, landed on step-1, later produced a real hazard failure, and restarted. touch-action was none, scroll stayed 0/0, and scrollWidth/clientWidth were both 390; mobile-first-landing.png records the landing.

checks.name: original expression and clean runtime
checks.evidence: No Slice Master/Poki/CrazyGames/Friv brand reference was found in authored source; visible title, geometry, UI, level layout, and values are original. The self-contained build made no failed requests and recorded zero console or page errors on desktop and mobile.
